Mammalian tuberculosis remains a disease of major concern in zoos because of the zoonotic nature of the pathogen. It is most often found on routine screening rather than as clinical cases in primates, hoofstock, and elephants.

evidence.value: origine région du fleuve Amour, Russie
evidence.quote: These rare cats originate in the Amur River region of Russia, which is situated in the Amur Forest.
It is possible that Ussuri cats are the result of an Amur leopard or an Amur Forest cat mating with domestic cats.
As one of the world's rarest cat breeds, The Ussuri is not formally recognized by any cat Association.
A fully grown Ussuri cat might weigh between 11-15 pounds or more and range in height anywhere from about 9"- 11" inches tall.
Ussuri cats are rare indeed - in fact, this unusual cat is among the rarest breeds on the planet.
